(frog-tddft)=
# frog-tddft

<!-- Generated by generate_readme.py from the CLI definitions in src/frogchem/cli. Do not edit by hand. -->

{bdg-warning}`Spectroscopy & grids` Summarise TD-DFT excited states, SOC and charge transfer, and plot UV/ECD spectra.

## What it does

A TD-DFT calculation gives the vertical excited states of a molecule: their energies, how bright
they are in absorption (oscillator strength f), their sign in circular dichroism (rotatory
strength R) and which orbitals are involved. This command turns the long ORCA/Gaussian output into
one readable table, draws the **UV-Vis** and **ECD** spectra (to compare with experiment or to
assign the absolute configuration from ECD), shows the **spin-orbit couplings** (SOC) between
singlets and triplets (relevant for intersystem crossing, phosphorescence, TADF), and measures
whether an excitation is **local** or **charge transfer** (CT) with the D_CT index (distance
between the regions where electron density is lost and gained). With a conformer ensemble it
Boltzmann-averages states and spectra.

## How it works

```{include} _parts/frog-tddft/how_it_works.md
```

## Input

An **ORCA output of a TD-DFT (or TDA) calculation**, e.g. `! B3LYP def2-TZVP` with
`%tddft nroots 10 end` (more roots = wider spectrum; 10–30 is typical for UV-Vis). Rotatory
strengths for ECD are printed by ORCA automatically. For triplets add `triplets true`, for SOC
`dosoc true` inside `%tddft`. A **Gaussian 16** output with `td=(nstates=10)` is also read
(energies, f, R and transitions; with `td=(50-50,nstates=10)` singlets and triplets are numbered
S1…, T1… as in ORCA; checked against ORCA `tda false` on (R)-methyloxirane).

For `--dct` the output must also contain the basis set and all the MO coefficients: ORCA
`! PrintBasis PrintMOs`; Gaussian `#p ... pop=full iop(3/33=1) iop(6/80=1) gfinput` (pure `5D 7F` or
Cartesian `6D 10F` functions). Alternatively give an existing difference-density cube
(`.cube`, e.g. written by an earlier `--dct` run) and it is analysed directly. For `-c` you need a
`checkpoint.json` (or csv/json) with Boltzmann populations of the conformers.

### Arguments

**Positional arguments**

| Argument | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `files` … | required | ORCA/Gaussian output files or CUBE files |

**Options**

| Argument | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--raw-orbitals` |  | Show orbital numbers instead of frontier labels (H, L, H-1, ...) |
| `--soc-states` `SOC_STATES …` |  | States to show in the SOC matrix (e.g. S0 S1 T1 T2, S0-S3, T1-T5) |
| `--soc-singlets` `SOC_SINGLETS …` |  | Singlet indices to show in the SOC matrix (e.g. 0 1) |
| `--soc-triplets` `SOC_TRIPLETS …` |  | Triplet indices to show in the SOC matrix (e.g. 1 2) |

**Spectra**

| Argument | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--uv` |  | Plot the UV-Vis spectrum |
| `--ecd` |  | Plot the ECD spectrum |
| `--shift` `SHIFT` | `0.0` | Shift of the excitation energies in eV |
| `--fwhm` `FWHM` | `0.3` | Gaussian broadening FWHM in eV |
| `--x-start` `X_START` | `2.0` | Lower end of the energy window in eV |
| `--x-end` `X_END` | `8.0` | Upper end of the energy window in eV |
| `--save-spectra` |  | Also write the plotted curves as CSV next to each spectrum plot |
| `--save-pickle` |  | Also pickle each spectrum figure (.pickle next to the plot) |

**Charge transfer (dct)**

| Argument | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--dct` |  | Compute the difference densities and the charge-transfer distance Δr |
| `--dct-states` `DCT_STATES …` |  | States for the DCT analysis (e.g. S1 T1, S1-S3, T1); all if not given |
| `--dct-threshold` `DCT_THRESHOLD` | `100.0` | Density percentile kept when locating the Δρ centroids (100 = no trimming, as in the Le Bahers D_CT definition) |
| `--ct-threshold` `CT_THRESHOLD` | `2.0` | Δr in Å above which a state is labelled charge transfer |
| `--le-threshold` `LE_THRESHOLD` | `1.5` | Δr in Å below which a state is labelled local excitation |
| `--voxels` `VOXELS` | `60` | Grid points per dimension for the DCT grid |
| `--padding` `PADDING` | `3.0` | Grid padding around the molecule in Å |
| `--no-save-cube` |  | Do not write the difference-density cube files |
| `--chimerax` |  | Write the ChimeraX commands for the Δρ centroid spheres to <stem>_dct.cxc |

**Thresholds**

| Argument | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-t`, `--threshold` `THRESHOLD` | `0.2` | Minimum weight of an orbital transition to list it |

**Plot options**

| Argument | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--fig-format` `{png,svg,pdf,eps}` | `png` | Image format, unless the path already has an extension |
| `--dpi` `DPI` | `300` | Raster resolution of saved plots |
| `--show` |  | Also open the plot in an interactive window |
| `--title` `TEXT` |  | Plot title ('' removes it) |
| `--xlabel` `TEXT` |  | Label of the x axis |
| `--ylabel` `TEXT` |  | Label of the y axis |
| `--xlim` `MIN MAX` |  | Range of the x axis |
| `--ylim` `MIN MAX` |  | Range of the y axis |
| `--colors` `COLOR …` |  | Colours of the plotted series, in order (matplotlib names or #hex) |
| `--linewidth` `W` |  | Line width in points |
| `--linestyle` `{solid,dashed,dotted,dashdot}` |  | Line style |
| `--legend`, `--no-legend` |  | Show or hide the legend (default: decided by the plot) |
| `--grid`, `--no-grid` |  | Show or hide the grid (default: decided by the plot) |
| `--figsize` `W H` |  | Figure size in inches |
| `--font-size` `PT` |  | Base font size in points (titles and labels scale with it) |

**Ensemble averaging**

| Argument | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-c`, `--checkpoint` `PATH` |  | Checkpoint file (checkpoint.json, or csv/json) with Boltzmann populations for ensemble averaging |
| `--read-boltzmann` `PROTOCOL` |  | Protocol whose populations are read from the checkpoint (default: protocol of each file, or the latest) |
| `-e`, `--energy-term` `{E,EZPVE,H,G}` | `G` | Energy used for on-the-fly Boltzmann weights |
| `-T`, `--temp` `TEMP` | `298.15` | Temperature in K |
| `--individual` |  | Also show per-conformer results next to the ensemble average |

**Output**

| Argument | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-o`, `--output` `PREFIX` | `spectra` | Prefix of the aggregate spectra (superimposed, ensemble average), relative to the current directory |
| `--out-dir` `DIR` |  | Directory for per-input output files (default: next to each input file) |

Shared by every command: `-v/--verbose`, `-q/--quiet`, `--format {table,json,csv}`, `--table-file PATH` — see [CLI conventions](conventions.md).

## Output

| Kind | Name | When | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Terminal | `Excited States Summary (<file>)` | always | One row per state: multiplicity, energy (eV), f, R (1e-40 cgs), <S²> and the orbital transitions with weight above -t |
| Terminal | `Spin-Orbit Coupling (SOC) Matrix (<file>)` | always | SOC between singlets (rows) and triplets (columns), cm⁻¹; only for SOC calculations, filtered by --soc-states/--soc-singlets/--soc-triplets |
| Terminal | `Charge Transfer Distance Analysis (<file>)` | `--dct` | Per state: energy, wavelength, f, Δr (Å) with CT/LE class, CT dipole q_CT·Δr (e·Å) |
| Terminal | `Charge Transfer Distance (CUBE)` | always | Δr (Å), CT dipole q_CT·Δr (e·Å) and grid size of each CUBE input |
| Terminal | `Ensemble Weights (<n> conformers)` | `-c` | Conformer, protocol, file, Boltzmann population (%) and normalized weight (%) |
| Terminal | `Ensemble-Averaged Excited States (Boltzmann Weighted)` | `-c` | Weighted energy, f, R and <S²> per state, transitions of the most populated conformer |
| Terminal | `Ensemble-Averaged Spin-Orbit Coupling (SOC) Matrix (Boltzmann Weighted)` | `-c` | Weighted SOC matrix (cm⁻¹) |
| File | `<stem>_<state>_delta_rho.cube` | `--dct` | Difference density of each state (not with --no-save-cube) |
| File | `<stem>_dct.cxc` | `--chimerax` | ChimeraX script with the +/− centroid spheres of Δρ (blue/red), for --dct or CUBE inputs |
| File | `<plot>.csv` | `--save-spectra` | Normalized curves of every saved spectrum plot, same name: Energy_eV, Wavelength_nm, one column per curve |
| File | `<plot>.pickle` | `--save-pickle` | Pickled matplotlib figure of every saved spectrum plot |
| Plot | `<stem>_UV.png, <stem>_ECD.png` | `--uv/--ecd` | Spectrum of each file, next to it (or --out-dir) |
| Plot | `<prefix>_UV_superimposed.png` | `--uv/--ecd` | All files on one plot, only with 2 or more files; prefix from -o (spectra, in the current directory) |
| Plot | `<prefix>_UV_ensemble.png` | `-c --uv/--ecd` | Boltzmann-averaged spectrum (ECD likewise) |

### How to read it

**Excited States Summary**: one row per state with its label, multiplicity, **Energy (eV)**,
**f** (dimensionless), **R** (rotatory strength, 10⁻⁴⁰ cgs), **<S\*\*2>** and the orbital
transitions with their weight, e.g. `H->L (0.99)` (H = HOMO, L = LUMO, H-1 = HOMO−1; α/β marks the
spin in open-shell runs). States are labelled per multiplicity: **S1, S2… T1, T2… D1… Q1…**
(S0 is the ground state), and the same labels are used in the SOC matrix and in `--dct-states`.
To convert: λ (nm) = 1239.84 / E (eV).

* f > 0.1 is a bright transition, f < 0.01 essentially dark. R has a sign: its pattern
  (+/−) is what you compare with an experimental ECD spectrum; for an achiral molecule R ≈ 0.
* <S\*\*2> should be 0 for singlets and 2 for triplets (closed-shell reference); in open-shell
  (UKS) runs a value far from S(S+1) means spin contamination: be careful with that state.
* **SOC matrix**: rows S0, S1…, columns T1, T2…, values in cm⁻¹. ⟨S|H_SO|T⟩ of a few cm⁻¹ is
  typical for organic molecules; tens to hundreds of cm⁻¹ appear with heavy atoms or n→π*/π→π*
  (El-Sayed) state pairs.
* Spectra are **normalised** to a maximum of 1 (shape only, no ε in L mol⁻¹ cm⁻¹), on a wavelength
  axis with energy on top. The ECD bands are weighted by the transition energy (Δε ∝ E·R).
  TD-DFT with hybrid functionals typically overestimates energies by 0.1–0.4 eV, hence `--shift`.
* **D_CT** (Δr, Å): **< 1.5 Å** local excitation (*Local Exc.*), **> 2 Å** charge transfer
  (*Charge Trans.*), in between *Mixed CT/LE* (change with `--le-threshold`/`--ct-threshold`). The
  *Dipole Moment* column is q_CT·Δr in e·Å. A grid that is too coarse or a too small `--padding`
  makes Δr noisy: compare states computed with the same grid.
* An output whose TD-DFT part did not finish has no states: no table is printed (the UV/ECD
  plots are then empty). Check that the job ended normally.

Example (`soc.out`, PBE0/def2-TZVPP, `nroots 1`, `triplets true`, `dosoc true`): S1 2.778 eV,
f 0.080, R 20.696, `H->L (0.99)`; T1 2.506 eV, <S\*\*2> 2.000; SOC S0–T1 6.857 cm⁻¹ and S1–T1
1.040 cm⁻¹. Water (B3LYP/def2-TZVPP, `--dct --voxels 40`): S1 7.577 eV, f 0.034, Δr 0.86 Å
(Local Exc.).

## Step by step

1. Run `frog-tddft job.out` to print the excited-state table (and the SOC matrix if the job had `dosoc true`); lower `-t` (default 0.20) to see more orbital transitions per state, `--raw-orbitals` to see MO numbers instead of H/L labels.
2. Plot spectra with `--uv` and/or `--ecd`: the files `<stem>_UV.png` / `<stem>_ECD.png` go next to the output (or `--out-dir`). Adjust the band width with `--fwhm` (eV, default 0.3), shift all energies with `--shift` (eV, e.g. −0.2 to match experiment), set the window with `--x-start`/`--x-end` (eV, default 2–8 eV = 620–155 nm), and add `--save-spectra` to get the curves as CSV.
3. Several files (e.g. functionals, or conformers) → one plot each plus a superimposed plot `spectra_UV_superimposed.png` (prefix from `-o`); with `-c checkpoint.json` the states and the spectrum are Boltzmann-averaged (`spectra_UV_ensemble.png`).
4. Charge-transfer analysis: `--dct` for all states, or `--dct --dct-states S1-S3 T1` for some of them, with the same labels as the table; `--voxels` (default 60) sets the grid, `--chimerax` writes a ChimeraX script with the +/− centroids, `--no-save-cube` skips the Δρ cube files.
5. Restrict the SOC matrix to the states you care about with `--soc-states S0 S1 T1 T2` (ranges like `T1-T5` work).

Summarise TD-DFT excited states, SOC and charge transfer, and plot UV/ECD spectra.

Reads ORCA or Gaussian outputs: one table of excited states per file (energy, oscillator and
rotatory strength, <S²>, dominant orbital transitions) and the SOC matrix when present. --dct
computes the excited-state density differences on a grid and the charge-transfer distance Δr; CUBE
inputs are analysed directly. --uv/--ecd broaden the transitions with Gaussians and save the
spectra; with -c the excited states, SOC and spectra are Boltzmann averaged over the conformers.
